offers.source: Typed from THE BUILD §2.4 (sellers, origins, headings) and Diego's 2026-09-03 research (worked prices). Prices marked 'typed, unverified' were not read from a vendor page this session. SYNTHETIC sellers are invented for the demo and badged.

ownership.source: Hand-typed. REAL rows are public corporate facts with a URL each; they were typed from memory of public filings on 2026-09-05 and are badged 'unverified this session' until the URL is read. SYNTHETIC rows exist for the demo and are badged. A party with no row prints 'ownership unknown'.

tariff.source: Typed from THE BUILD §2.7 as corrected by Diego's 2026-09-03 research and 2026-09-05 validation and by the 2026-09-03 routing research. Base rates marked verified=false are 'expected' and were not read from the schedule this session. Overlay rows are data, never program logic; a rate change is a new fixture and old estimates keep pointing at the old one.
